newsitem.title: USA: Empire of Carolina says closing conditions met.
newsitem.headline: Empire of Carolina says closing conditions met.

text.p: Empire of Carolina INC said Tuesday that HPA Associates, LLC, private investors in the company, said that certain closing conditions for a $16 million investment in the company, have been satisfied and that funds are being placed in escrow to finance the purchase of preferred stock and warrants.
Closing, said Empire, will take place on or before June 16, pending documentation and satisfaction of final closing conditions.

The company also said that its lenders have extended, until June 30, the requirement that it obtain $6 million of additional financing by May 31, 1997 as required by the amendments to its senior loan agreement.

Empire of Carolina designs, develops, manufactures and markets a broad range of basic plastic children's toys. Its Holiday Products Division produces and markets decorative seasonal items including Christmas, Halloween and Easter illuminated products.
